text.p: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission said Monday that it has temporarily suspended trading in Amquest International Ltd until June 12.
The SEC said it halted trading beginning May 30 because of questions raised about the accuracy and adequacy of information the company disclosed.

The information involves reports of the Ft. Lauderdale, Fla., company's ownership of certain Brazilian rights and other assets, the value of those assets, amount of income and the "composition and involvement in company affairs of Amquest's purported management," the SEC said.

"The commission cautions broker-dealers, shareholders, and prospective purchases that they should carefully consider the foregoing information along with all other currently available information and any information subsequently issued by the company," the SEC said.
